core_conclusion: Show every channel's actual occupation-law match after a development-selected controller parameter adaptation, including remaining imperfect fits.
role: exploratory validation / patient-specific parameter adaptation preview
backend: Python/matplotlib, explicitly selected by the user in the established workflow
panels: 96 contacts, displayed in 3 pages of 36/36/24, original six-column geometry
separate_aggregate_diagnostics: 8 initialization contexts x 3 matched CRN banks, not 24 patients or independent biological replicates
curve_metric_link: Occupation KDE uses the displayed original-grid samples; empirical occupation/time W1 are computed from ALL raw standardized samples, including tails outside the plotting window.
normalization: Original predictive-model scaler fixed; no new min-max scaling, no per-series rescaling, no offsets to improve visual fit
KDE: Original absolute bandwidth .16 and original 240-point per-contact grid preserved for all four curves
annotation_policy: Channel names and shared four-line legend only, original standardized-amplitude axis retained; no distances, gate markers, bottom explanations, or additional loss diagram
n_definition: One retrospective patient; recorded ictal has 256 displayed samples/channel; free/controlled are paired 32-particle stochastic ensembles; reference path count saved in output QA
statistical_claims: No significance or confidence-interval claim from displayed KDE; one optimization seed, no global optimality or per-channel no-harm guarantee
selection_scope: Both arm and checkpoint selected only on common development score and revised .45 resource budget; outer already revealed historically, post-hoc diagnostics only
review_risks: Loss reweighting may trade some per-channel or mean-bias endpoints for overall law fit
Budget relaxation itself does not improve the controller or establish physiological safety
Displayed one context must not be mistaken for full 8x3 average
Original plotting window may exclude extreme tails; metrics retain them
